subject: NeedlePoint bridge letter request — post-audit coverage clarification
messages:
From: Amira Khan <amira.k@needlepoint.io>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: bridge letter to cover post-report gap

Hi Irene,

Hope you’re well — we’re finalizing our vendor security pack for a board review and noticed Redwood’s SOC 2 Type II report ends 2024-12-31. Our procurement team needs a short bridge letter that confirms there have been no material control changes since the report end date through today (or, if there are changes, a brief description). The buyer has asked for coverage through 2027-07-31.

Can Redwood produce a bridge letter or temporary assertion for the period 2025-01-01 through 2027-07-31? If possible, we’d like a PDF we can attach to our packet and a signed DocuSign copy for our records. ETA for our side is next Tuesday, 2027-07-06.

Also useful: confirmation of the SOC 2 report file name you want referenced and any limitations/exclusions we should call out.

Thanks — appreciate a quick confirmation on feasibility and timing.

Best,
Amira Khan
Security & Procurement
NeedlePoint Technologies
Attachments: procurement_checklist.xlsx (see line 12: SOC cover letter required)
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Amira Khan <amira.k@needlepoint.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: bridge letter to cover post-report gap

Hi Amira — thanks for the clear ask. We can provide a bridge letter (temporary assertion) but I need to confirm a couple items internally before we finalize language and sign:

1) Exact coverage window you want referenced in the letter (you wrote through 2027-07-31 — confirm start date you expect us to assert).
2) Whether you need an attestation of no material control changes, or a list of changes and compensating controls if any exist. Our standard approach is to confirm no material changes and call out any minor control updates.
3) Preferred signatory (we usually have Head of Security or VP Legal sign these).

I’m looping in Laura (Security Operations) and Marcus (Compliance) to review the draft. I’ll share a draft by EOW for your review and a DocuSign link once legal signs off.

Irene Choi
Director, Trust & Security
Redwood Inference

----Original Attachment(s) referenced: procurement_checklist.xlsx
From: Amira Khan <amira.k@needlepoint.io>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evan Chu <evan.chu@needlepoint.io>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 08:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: bridge letter to cover post-report gap

Hi Irene — thanks for the quick reply.

Confirming: coverage window should be 2025-01-01 through 2027-07-31 (our contract with Redwood began 2025-01-01 and the procurement checklist asks for continuous control coverage since contract start). We need the letter to state either: (A) no material changes to controls affecting the scope of SOC 2 since the report end date (2024-12-31) OR (B) disclose any material changes and the compensating controls in place. If you can do (A) that’s preferred.

Signatory: Doc-level signed by VP Legal or Head of Security is acceptable.

We’d appreciate the PDF and a DocuSign link by 2027-07-06 if possible; if not, please let us know the earliest date you can commit to.

Thanks,
Amira
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2027 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: FW: Request: bridge letter to cover post-report gap — needlepoint request and draft attached

Marcus / Priyom — can you please review the attached draft bridge letter and confirm that (1) we can assert no material control changes since 2024-12-31 through 2027-07-31 for the scopes listed, and (2) whether Legal prefers any additional language around limitations or evidence retention? I’ve attached a one-page draft (Redwood_Bridge_Letter_Draft_20270705.docx) and the referenced SOC2_TypeII_Report_2024.pdf for context.

If acceptable, please confirm the signatory to route to DocuSign (VP Legal typically). NeedlePoint has requested a PDF + DocuSign by 2027-07-06; if we can’t meet that, suggest an alternative ETA.

Thanks — Irene

Attachment(s): Redwood_Bridge_Letter_Draft_20270705.docx, SOC2_TypeII_Report_2024.pdf
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Jul 2027 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Request: bridge letter to cover post-report gap — needlepoint request and draft attached

Irene / team — reviewed the draft and the control records. We can confirm the following for NeedlePoint:

• Coverage period: we will assert continuity from 2025-01-01 through 2027-07-31 with reference to the SOC 2 Type II report (report period ending 2024-12-31).
• Assertion language: we will state that, to the best of Redwood Inference’s knowledge and based on our change control and design documentation, there have been no material changes to the controls in scope that would affect the SOC 2 report’s conclusions.
• Limitations: include a single paragraph noting that the bridge letter is not a replacement for a full SOC 2 examination and that it relies on internal change-control evidence.

I’ll route the finalized PDF to VP Legal (Priyom) and request signature via DocuSign; expect the DocuSign envelope and final PDF by EOD 2027-07-05. Attaching the signed-ready PDF and DocuSign routing note once complete.

Marcus Lin
Senior Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment(s): Redwood_Bridge_Letter_Final_20270705.pdf (to be attached), DocuSign_Link.txt
